full_text:
James K. Morgan
Preserved Primary Document • morganj4.htm
There was an old family tradition that Jim K. and his brother were carpenters who went up to Philadelphia to work on the Centennial Exposition where they met, and later married, Araminta Sisco and her sister who were from Lancaster Co., PA. My work on the Siscos, however, indicates that Araminta and her siblings were all born in Delaware. However, Araminta's sister, Isabella Sisco, did marry Isaiah Durham who was James' step-brother, the son of William and Mahala Songo Durham Morgan.
James ("Jim K.") was a carpenter. He and Araminta lived in Cheswold DE and had at least 8 children:
Harvey Morgan (b.
1879
